About Lions

Lions Barbers is based on Mint Walk in Croydon, with a focus on male grooming. The shop's Booksy profile describes 30 years of experience.

Services listed include haircuts, skin fades, beard grooming, shape ups and children's haircuts.

Before you visit

How do I book?

Follow the Booksy link, choose your service and select an available appointment.

Can I pay by card?

Booksy lists credit cards as accepted.

Is the shop accessible and child-friendly?

Booksy lists disability access and a child-friendly venue. Contact the shop through Booksy for specific access needs.
